source.title: Fall of the Grand Crusader
source.description:
The path forward now is simple and brutal. Breach the inner sanctum of the Scarlet Enclave and confront the new self-proclaimed "Grand Crusader"  Baelin Caldoran. Bring him to justice for his crimes. We'll stay here and secure this position to ensure that no remnant forces harass you from behind.

Bring that monster to justice.
source.completion:
Caldoran is no more but the victory is bittersweet. It has been a bloody day. With the Scarlet Crusade's remaining forces scattered and the Scarlet Enclave in flames, we've done a great thing here. There's still much work to do in the Plaguelands, but at least we have one less adversary to worry about for now. As far as I am concerned, that is a cause for celebration.

For the Light! For Lordaeron! For the Dawn!
